posts.title: See what's new in Update
posts.details:
Control Center → Update now lists every release: Latest, All, and Not installed.

When a new version is out, Anserin tells you once and can update itself with one click. It checks GitHub a minute after you log in and then every 6 hours.

Some new features will arrive turned off. Open one and press Turn on to try it, and Turn off to go back.

posts.title: The Default interface is gone
posts.details:
Anserin is now the only interface. The bar, the floating Quick Actions and the separate Settings window are removed, along with the switch between interfaces.

If you were still on the Default interface, Anserin moves you over once and keeps your settings.

posts.title: New installs start in Anserin
posts.details: A fresh install now opens the Anserin interface you see in the screenshots.

report.where: Right after installing, on the first start
report.wrong: Anserin opened the old Default interface with a bar, not the Anserin interface
report.changed: New installs start in Anserin, and the old interface is removed

posts.title: Anserin is out
posts.details:
The first public version of Anserin. It comes with the Anserin interface, the left panel with Bubble, Control Center on the right edge, the corner revolver, the duck and the Simple lock screen.

Install it with the installer, and update with anserin -up.
